issue-10252-initial-flip.reason: Svelte #10252: the first simultaneous crossfade with keyed FLIP displaces visible rows by 80px before their animations begin on upstream 5.57.3 Chromium

issue-10252-interrupted.reason: Svelte #10252 rapid shuffles: on upstream 5.57.3 Chromium the first crossfade+FLIP shuffle displaces three tiles by 80px, and a second shuffle at 400ms jumps the restarted senders by 40-80px and ends re-FLIPped receivers 40-80px from their slots

issue-10252-paired-layout.reason: Upstream 5.57.3 starts only four of eight expected no-FLIP crossfade motions when a user-deferred receive wrapper registers during resolution; Vigla settles all registrations before shared source and target endpoint measurement

issue-10252-placement.reason: Upstream 5.57.3 keeps matched senders in flow, displacing the grouped grid source by 41px at time zero; the same public row checks absolute/fixed/flex placement, authored declaration restoration, re-entry and untouched authored animations

issue-17969-contenteditable.reason: Svelte #17969: deleting dynamic plaintext-only contenteditable text, toggling editing off/on and inserting abc produces abcabc in the heading while the model remains abc on upstream 5.57.3 Chromium

issue-4313-equal-css.reason: Svelte #4313: anonymous public compilation with injected CSS gives equally authored but differently pruned sheets one id on upstream 5.57.3, so the later yellow element remains transparent

media-binding-lifetime.reason: Upstream 5.57.3 retains video resize listeners after the video branch disappears, so a retained element overwrites new parent dimensions with [0,0] instead of preserving [123,456]
